Method of Attack: The package is a trojanized version of the legitimate SentinelOne SDK client, stealing sensitive data from compromised developer systems
Impacted Systems: Developer systems using the SentinelOne package from PyPI
Attack Vector: The package steals and uploads data to an IP address not belonging to SentinelOne's infrastructure
Indicators of Compromise: Stolen data includes Bash and Zsh histories, SSH keys, .gitconfig files, hosts files, AWS configuration info, Kube configuration info
